data.content: All potential approval gates were front-loaded on 2026-08-25. Approved: GitHub rules/Actions, Diffinite receive controls/service identity/deploy, all local SQLite migrations and data rewrites, GitHub publication/releases, canaries, and additive archives. No later human rollout gate. Defaults: poison enabled; disposable-ref infrastructure canary; shemcp then compactor product canaries; automatic per-repo cutover after green bridge/protection/equivalence probes; indefinite archive retention. Production PostgreSQL schema changes, new hosts, DNS/TLS/network work, and archive deletion are not required.
